items.question: What is the true nature of the jīva and what becomes of it when the body is abandoned?
premises: The supreme is partless eternal and stainless.
The jīva is identified with the supreme haṃsa.
The air pervades all beings as situated wind.
items.inference: The jīva is ultimately the supreme Śiva, realized through heard knowledge.
uncertainties: Some adjectival endings are morphologically ambiguous between accusative and neuter nominative.
items.plain_english: He is the supreme, partless, eternal, free from disease and stainless.
